turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I have deduced that you are in a precarious situation, Your Majesty, and I must warn you that discretion is paramount in this matter.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Yes, I am indeed in a delicate position, and I fear for the consequences if this matter were to become public.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Pray tell, Your Majesty, what is the nature of this situation that requires such secrecy?

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: This involves a lady, a Miss Irene Adler, and a matter of great import to the House of Ormstein.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Yes, Miss Adler, a woman of great intelligence and cunning, has obtained certain... documents, shall we say, that could compromise my family's reputation and security.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Fascinating, I must say, Your Majesty, that this lady appears to have a most... interesting relationship with you.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: It is a complicated matter, Watson, and one that requires great tact and discretion on our part.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I beg of you, gentlemen, to help me retrieve these documents and prevent a scandal that could bring ruin to my house.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Very well, Your Majesty, we shall do what we can to assist you, but I must warn you that our efforts may not be successful.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Tell me, Your Majesty, how did Miss Adler obtain these documents, and what makes you so certain they are in her possession?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear I may have been too trusting, gentlemen, and Miss Adler has taken advantage of my... vulnerability.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I see, Your Majesty, and I must say that your situation is indeed precarious.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: But surely, Your Majesty, there are those in your household who could help you retrieve these documents?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Alas, I fear not, Watson, for I have already taken measures to ensure that no one within my household is aware of the situation.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Very well, Your Majesty, we shall proceed as you have instructed, but I must caution you that our efforts may be futile.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Tell me, Sherlock, what do you propose we do next in this case?

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I propose, Your Majesty, that we pay a visit to Miss Adler's residence and attempt to retrieve the documents.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Oh, dear gentlemen, I fear for your safety, for Miss Adler is not one to be underestimated.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Fear not, Your Majesty, for we are equipped to handle the situation.
